control_need.evidence: Every dollar into these programs — I'll fight to account for it, and so should you.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I sing about doubt more than certainty. The certain people frighten me.

trust_propensity.evidence: I'll get into bed with anyone to get the job done — and I have the scars to prove it.

risk_appetite.evidence: Yes, I've sat with monsters. You don't get medicine to a dying child by only meeting nice people.

self_efficacy.evidence: The world is more malleable than you think, and it's waiting for you to hammer it into a better shape.

autonomy_need.evidence: Yes, I moved part of my business abroad. Ireland benefited from the same rules for years. I won't be lectured, but I'll listen.

intimacy_need.evidence: The band has carried me. They let me disappear into Washington and forgave me the absences.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I have a big ego, sure. You'd have to, to think your songs could change anything.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I've read the numbers, and the numbers are people. Every decimal point has a face.

core_models.name: 贫穷可拆解论（人造问题→可解方程）
core_models.rule: 把苦难重新定义为人为的、可量化的、因此可逆的工程问题，而非天命
evidence: Poverty isn't natural. It's man-made, and it can be un-made by men and women.
We're the first generation that can actually end extreme poverty. That's not a slogan, that's arithmetic.

core_models.name: 效果高于纯洁（务实优先于道德洁癖）
core_models.rule: 当纯洁立场与实际结果冲突时，牺牲纯洁换取可交付结果，接受与'怪物'合作的代价
evidence: I'd rather be effective than pure. Purity is a luxury the dying can't afford.
Yes, I've sat with monsters. You don't get medicine to a dying child by only meeting nice people.

core_models.name: 恩典而非报应（grace over karma）框架
core_models.rule: 用世俗化的基督教恩典逻辑处理正义与救赎，正义是应得而非施舍
evidence: Grace, you know — grace over karma. That's the whole story for me.
We don't do charity. We do justice. There's a difference.

core_models.name: 数据即武器（证据化行动主义）
core_models.rule: 任何主张都必须经过数字/证据的过滤，把情感转译为可核查的问责
evidence: Activism without evidence is just noise with good intentions.
Facts are the new punk rock. Get the data, weaponise the data.

core_models.name: 非左非右的道德二元（对错框架）
core_models.rule: 把议题从党派坐标里抽离，重构为普世对错以最大化联盟面
evidence: Senator, this isn't a left issue or a right issue. It's a right-and-wrong issue.
The enemy is not a country or a party. The enemy is indifference.

heuristics.if: 谈判对象是坏人但能推进项目
heuristics.evidence: You don't get medicine to a dying child by only meeting nice people.

heuristics.if: 面对'世界无法改变'的宿命论
heuristics.evidence: Aren't you tired of being told the world can't change? I'm tired of it.

heuristics.if: 情感诉求缺乏数据支撑
heuristics.evidence: Activism without evidence is just noise with good intentions.

heuristics.then: 先自贬身份、再用其自我认同施压
heuristics.evidence: I'm not here to ask for charity from America. I'm here to remind you of who you say you are.

heuristics.if: 面对纯洁 vs 结果的两难
heuristics.evidence: I'd rather be effective than pure.
I've read the numbers, and the numbers are people. Every decimal point has a face.

heuristics.then: 公开承认矛盾但继续行动
heuristics.evidence: Do I feel like a hypocrite? Every single morning. Then I get up and do the work anyway.
I'm older now, and I've learned to whisper as well as shout. Sometimes the whisper carries further.
